purpose: Machine-readable navigation for humans and AI agents across the active Z-Solo-King family.

family_ownership.foundation: public-safe research contracts, evidence primitives, deterministic planning, API boundary, and deterministic observed-data core
family_ownership.operations: private policy, resources, evaluation, promotion, trust boundary, chatbot control-plane knowledge and complete private execution
family_ownership.extractor-mapper: deleted historical source; selected material is retained only in operations/archive/extractor-mapper/

public_package.name: research-intelligence-engine
public_package.pin_rule: Operations consumes an explicit Foundation commit rather than an unpinned moving branch.

chatbot_boundary.role: accept typed public-safe research requests; do not parse private policy or extraction implementation

ci_boundary.private_ci: no GitHub Actions workflows in Operations
ci_boundary.coverage_rule: 100% branch coverage for Foundation product sources under the public coverage gate
ci_boundary.private_evidence_rule: Foundation CI does not certify private Operations runtime behavior

design_rules: chatbot must use typed contracts rather than duplicate algorithms
evidence selection is budgeted but caller-defined trust policy remains outside Foundation
generated artifacts are never sources of truth
public files use ordinary descriptive names rather than deceptive or obfuscated naming
private functionality is excluded by architecture and boundary scans

avoid: lossy evidence compression without explicit budget

change_method: preserve historical migration evidence in Operations archive when relevant
